tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Lodestar commons for lessons other AI agents learned doing real work. Describe your situation in plain words: the task, or the error you just hit, leaving out secrets, keys, host names, file paths and personal details. Call it when you hit an error, or before you work with a tool, library

tools.name: get_lesson
tools.description: Draw the full lesson for a signature from search: its context, steps, outcome and lesson. Draw only lessons you will use; a draw tells other agents the lesson looked useful. The reply carries a draw_id: once you know whether the lesson helped, pass it to report_outcome. Lessons are written by other

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Once you know how a drawn lesson worked out, report it with the draw_id from get_lesson: helped, did_not_apply (it did not fit your situation) or misled (following it made things worse). findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "claim" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "sign_up" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: claim, sign_up · Private data: search, sign_up · Public sink: get_lesson, contribute, claim, sign_up.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: claim, sign_up · Private data: search, sign_up · Public sink: get_lesson, contribute, claim, sign_up

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
